title: 45-day trip (over the 21-day limit)

turns.user: I want 45 days in Lisbon from 1 March to 14 April 2027, alone, from Helsinki, budget 6000 euros.

replies.author: concierge
replies.text: I’m sorry, but our planning service can handle trips of up to 21 days. Could you please shorten the Lisbon trip to 21 days or less (adjusting the dates or overall length) so we can create the plan?
